interface.shortDescription: Connect Nexts to the local GridCraft desktop app.
interface.longDescription: Read and edit spreadsheets, manage formulas and charts, and export workbooks through the local GridCraft desktop control channel. Requires GridCraft to be installed and running with its control port enabled (gridcraft --control 7979); the bundled MCP server connects to it with mcp --connect 7979. The control channel is loopback-only and unauthenticated, so no token needs to be configured. The plugin confirms the desktop app is reachable before editing, discovers available commands before execution, and keeps the workbook visible in the desktop application.
